rows.Kwic: 一行三昧者，法界一相之謂也。謂萬善雖殊，皆正於一行者也。

Override.AttributionNote: Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch (六祖大師法寶壇經), Praise of the Platform Sutra (六祖大師法寶壇經贊). The section byline reads 'composed by Song-dynasty Mingjiao master Qisong' (宋明教大師契嵩撰); Qisong, not Huineng, defines single-practice samadhi here as the single aspect of the dharma realm and the many goods rectified in one practice.

rows.Kwic: 無相戒者，戒其必正覺也。

Override.AttributionNote: Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch (六祖大師法寶壇經), Praise of the Platform Sutra (六祖大師法寶壇經贊). The section byline names Qisong as its composer (宋明教大師契嵩撰); Qisong, not Huineng, gives the direct gloss 'formless precepts are precepts concerning necessary correct awakening.'

rows.Kwic: 無相戒，戒之最也；四弘願，願之極也；無相懺，懺之至也。

Override.AttributionNote: Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch (六祖大師法寶壇經), Praise of the Platform Sutra (六祖大師法寶壇經贊). The section is explicitly composed by Qisong (宋明教大師契嵩撰); Qisong, not Huineng, appraises formless precepts as foremost among precepts.

rows.Kwic: 西京智光律師為授戒師，蘇州慧靜律師為羯磨，荊州通應律師為教授，中天耆多羅律師為說戒，西國蜜多三藏為證戒。

Override.AttributionNote: Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch (六祖大師法寶壇經), Outer Record of the Sixth Patriarch's Origins (六祖大師緣起外紀). The section is explicitly compiled by the disciple Fahai and others (門人法海等集); Fahai is the named lead compiler narrating the five ordination offices, while Huineng is the recipient and biographical subject, not the narrator.
